captions.detailed: A hub-and-spoke motion rig consisting of a tall, vertical black mast anchored to a rectangular base plate with supporting gussets. Mounted on opposite sides of the mast at different heights are two grey hub blocks, each supporting a single copper-colored cylindrical spoke arm. The two spoke arms are independent and articulate via revolute joints, allowing each arm to rotate around its horizontal hub axis.
captions.instruction: Create a hub-and-spoke motion rig with a tall vertical black mast on a rectangular base plate supported by two triangular gussets. Mount two grey hub blocks at different heights on opposite sides of the mast, and attach a copper-colored cylindrical spoke arm to each hub using a revolute joint so they can rotate independently.
captions.factory: The base mast is constructed using a vertical box primitive joined with a flat rectangular base plate and two triangular gussets. Two grey hub blocks are modeled as rectangular boxes with central cylindrical cutouts. Each spoke arm is constructed as a cylinder with a square-profile mounting hub at one end. These components are organized into an articulated assembly with two revolute joints positioned at the centers of the hub cutouts.
